endings/epilogue_depths.title: Depths of the axis
endings/epilogue_depths.body:
The stone descends. You did not close the dungeon — you changed stratum. Here silence weighs like a lower ceiling; the air arrives old in the lungs.

Victory carved more **Echoes** into the legacy. Spend them in the shop or restart when the abyss calls.

endings/epilogue_true_depths.title: True depths
endings/epilogue_true_depths.body:
The stone stops descending. You closed the axis at the **bottom** — not in the ash sky. Here silence weighs like hot victory.

Victory carved **Echoes** into the legacy. Spend them in the shop or restart when the abyss calls.

shared/explore_nav_act2.title: Perimeter of the tunnels
shared/explore_nav_act2.body:
**Silence** here is not lack of sound — it is the weight of stone. Each step asks if you return to the Vigil's fire or stay with the echo.

With the **torn map**, you see where the corridor lies less; without it, only skin and haste remain.

shared/game_over.title: Journey's End
shared/game_over.body:
Something in you yields without a crash. The **Dungeon of Silence** opens and closes like a wound; your name becomes a whisper in the damp.

Silence noted what you reached. The **Echoes** keep that weight between runs — you can spend them or restart.

shared/kaelsworn_oath.title: Oath of ash
shared/kaelsworn_oath.body:
**Kael** removes the **helm** — tired face, clean gaze.

> *"**Three** times I fell. **Three** times you did not lie in the strike. That is enough: I serve as **iron** that bends only to your hand."*

shared/kaelsworn_post_act2.title: Iron that yields
shared/kaelsworn_post_act2.body:
**Kael** tips the helm; the metal scrapes low.

> *"It was not victory — it was a **count**. When the number closes, the iron speaks."*

Withdraw — there is a door and there is haste

onEnterDiaryTexts: Kael retreated in the bone room — not from fear, from measure. The grey trail stayed on the floor like a deferred promise.

shared/kaelsworn_post_act4.title: Iron at the threshold
shared/kaelsworn_post_act4.body:
**Kael** sets the sword in the shadow of his step — not as threat, as a marker.

> *"The axis bends; I do not. Count again."*

choices.text: Hear what the iron promises — oath
Withdraw toward the ice

onEnterDiaryTexts: At the threshold of the grey wind, Kael bent for the length of a heartbeat. The throne stayed behind; the trail, ahead.

shared/kaelsworn_post_act5.title: Iron in the frost
shared/kaelsworn_post_act5.body:
Steam gnaws the steel. **Kael** laughs low — the sound of wet stone.

> *"Cold tests the joint. You passed. What remains is whether you accept what the joint demands."*

choices.text: Hear what the iron promises — oath
Retreat to camp — the lair waits

onEnterDiaryTexts: At the door of the white breath, Kael scraped ice from his shoulder as one scraping a name. Three counted blows — the iron wanted to speak.

shared/kaelsworn_post_act6.title: Iron in the rib
shared/kaelsworn_post_act6.body:
**Kael** looks smaller against the impossible angle — the armor does not: it stays straight.

> *"Here even the echo does not lie. If you swear, swear once — or stay silent forever."*

choices.text: Hear what the iron promises — oath
Retreat to the fractured nave

onEnterDiaryTexts: On the rib the map denies, Kael touched his breastplate as one closing a book. The void heard the iron without contest.

shared/lore/world_wound_surface.title: Before the green
shared/lore/world_wound_surface.body:
Before the **green pulse**, the village still pretended morning: dry bread, early doors, wells that tasted of iron. The harvest thinned without drought — only less warmth in the hands.

Then the air grew too **sweet**. Someone shut the window and called it wind. No one looked down.

choices.text: Keep remembering — what drains the village
Stop for now — back to the moment
Stop for now — back to the fire

shared/lore/world_wound_drain.title: What drains
shared/lore/world_wound_drain.body:
No army came. Something **pulls**: hearth warmth, names on the tongue, the sound left between two sentences. Routine becomes a mask — market open, eyes down.

At night, a **bell** echo rises without striking bronze. The **Third Bell**, say those who still speak low. The rest call it wind and shut the door.

choices.text: Keep remembering — why you descend

shared/lore/world_wound_oath.title: At the root
shared/lore/world_wound_oath.body:
Someone had to go down. Not for glory — because above only sweet lies and bitter wells remained. *{{playerName}}* closed a hand on the gear and chose the **dungeon**.

The root of the evil is not in the square. It is below, where **silence** swallows the rest.

choices.text: Keep the vow and return to the moment
choices.preview: Memory closes; the dungeon mouth waits.

onEnterDiaryTexts: I remembered the village before the green — and why *{{playerName}}* descends: to find the root of what drains.
